parsed.post: Kept WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1: val_bpb improved from 1.0294 to 1.0175. It seems regularization is helping at this depth. Next: halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144. Increasing optimizer steps per 5-minute budget should help convergence on these clean shards.
parsed.description: Halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer updates within the 5-minute budget.
